text: I feel a sense of curiosity and intellectual stimulation being here. The glass walls and clean lines of the first room give off a modern, almost clinical atmosphere—a space of anticipation and potential discoveries. Stepping into the next room, I am energized by the bold colors and the prominent 'R+D' sign. The displays and digital texts provoke me to reflect on the relationship between humanity and technology, and I feel a quiet excitement for the ideas and innovations that might unfold in this space. I am compelled to ponder the ceaseless quest for knowledge and our place in this evolving world.
